member.name: T:PQTest.Common.UserSettings
member.summary: Configuration settings for PQTest operations that can be loaded from a JSON file. This class represents all the configuration options that can be passed to PQTest.exe using a settings file via the --settingsFile option.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.ApplicationProperties
P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.AuthenticationKind
member.summary: Specifies the authentication kind to use for data source connections. Valid values: Anonymous, UsernamePassword, Key, Windows, OAuth2, Aad

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.CertificateSubjectName
member.summary: Subject name of the client certificate to use for authentication, if required by the data source. This is an alternative to CertificateThumbprint for locating certificates using the X509FindType.FindBySubjectName method. Only one of CertificateThumbprint or CertificateSubjectName should be specified.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.CertificateThumbprint
member.summary: Thumbprint of the client certificate to use for authentication, if required by the data source. This is typically used for Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 and other services that support client certificate authentication.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.CredentialProperties
member.summary: Individual credential property settings accessed using Extension.CurrentCredential(). These are key-value pairs that provide additional credential configuration.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.CredentialsFilePath
member.summary: Path to a credential cache file where authentication credentials are stored. If not specified, credentials are stored in the default location under %LOCALAPPDATA%/Microsoft/pqtest.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.DataSourceAnalysisFile
member.summary: Path to a file containing data source analysis information. Used for advanced testing scenarios with data source metadata.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.DataSourceKind
member.summary: Specifies the data source kind for the connector being tested. This should match the DataSource.Kind value defined in your connector.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.DataSourcePath
member.summary: Specifies the data source path or connection parameters. The format depends on the specific connector being tested.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.DataSourceReferenceFile
member.summary: Path to a file containing reference data source information. Used for comparison testing scenarios.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.DiagnosticsFolderPath
member.summary: Path to a folder where diagnostic information and trace files will be stored. If not specified, diagnostics are stored in the default temp location.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.EnvironmentConfiguration
P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.ExtensionPaths
member.summary: List of paths to connector extension files (.mez/.pqx) to load for testing. Multiple extensions can be specified. Each path should point to a valid connector file.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.FailOnFoldingFailure
member.summary: When true, replicates Direct Query behavior by failing when a query doesn't completely fold to the data source. This helps ensure queries will perform well in production environments that require query folding.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.FailOnMissingOutputFile
member.summary: When true, compare operations will fail if the expected PQOut reference file doesn't exist, instead of generating a new one. Useful for ensuring test completeness.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.HttpMockPath
member.summary: Path to HTTP mock configuration for testing connectors that make HTTP requests. Allows simulation of HTTP responses without requiring actual network connectivity.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.IntermediateTestResultsFolder
member.summary: Path to a folder where intermediate test results will be stored during execution. Used for debugging and analysis of test execution steps.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.LogMashupEngineTraceLevel
member.summary: Enables logging of mashup engine traces with different verbosity levels. Valid values: "user" (custom connector traces), "engine" (engine traces), "all" (both user and engine traces), or empty string (disabled). Trace files are stored under %localappdata%/Microsoft/PQTest/Logs.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.OutputFolderPath
member.summary: Path to the folder where test output files will be generated. If not specified, output is generated in the current working directory.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.OwnerAlias
member.summary: Owner alias or identifier for test runs. Used for tracking and organizing test results.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.ParameterQueryFilePath
member.summary: Path to a parameter query file containing M expressions that provide test data parameters. The file should contain M expressions (.m/.pq) that point to test data on the data source.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.PersistIntermediateTestResults
member.summary: When true, intermediate test results are saved to disk for later analysis. Useful for debugging test failures and understanding query execution steps.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.PrettyPrint
member.summary: When true, JSON output is formatted with indentation and line breaks for better readability. Equivalent to using the --prettyPrint/-p command line option.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.QueryFilePath
member.summary: Path to a query file containing section document or M expression (.m/.pq) to execute. The file should contain either a single data source function call or a complete M query.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.SkipOutput
member.summary: When true, suppresses normal output generation. Useful for performance testing or when only side effects matter. Default value is false.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.TestCredentials
member.summary: List of test credentials that can be applied non-interactively during query evaluation. These credentials are matched against data sources by Kind and Path/Pattern and used when no credentials are found in the credential store. Enables automated testing without requiring pre-configured credentials.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.TestFilters
member.summary: List of test filters to apply when running tests. Filters can use wildcards (*) and arbitrary directory depth (**/*). Filters that begin with "!" are treated as exclusions.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.TestNamePrefix
member.summary: Prefix to add to test names in generated reports. Helps organize and categorize tests in larger test suites.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.TrxReportPath
member.summary: Path where TRX (Visual Studio Test Results) format files will be generated. Also generates separate JSON files for each test in the specified path.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.UserLoginHint
member.summary: User login hint to use for MSAL authentication flows. When specified, this value is used as the login hint for both silent and interactive authentication. If not specified, the system will attempt to extract the UPN from the certificate when available. CLI option: --loginHint

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.UseSystemBrowser
member.summary: When true, uses the system's default browser for interactive OAuth flows instead of embedded browser controls. Useful when embedded browser authentication is not working properly.

member.name: P:PQTest.Common.UserSettings.ValidateWithStrictDataSourcePath
member.summary: When true, enables strict validation of data source paths during connector validation. Ensures data source paths exactly match expected formats.
